_source: Germany, 16 Laender = the 16 game regions (DE1 to DEG). upper_secondary_school. SCOPE, the rule for every nation: FULL-TIME upper-secondary pupils, general and vocational, and teachers in full-time equivalents, both from one table family and one school year (2024/25). Pupils and teachers: Kultusministerkonferenz (KMK), Dokumentation Nr. 248 'Schueler/-innen, Klassen, Lehrkraefte und Absolvierende der Schulen 2015 bis 2024' (April 2026), Tabellenteil Z (SKL_Teil_Z_Zusammenfassung_2024.xlsx), Laendervergleich 2024, which is school year 2024/25: Z1.2 for pupils and Z3.2 for teachers in Vollzeitlehrkraefte-Einheiten (a part-time teacher counted by the share of a full post), rows of the Sekundarstufe II. In scope: the Sekundarstufe II of Gymnasien, of the Schularten mit drei Bildungsgaengen (comprehensive and Gemeinschaftsschulen) and of the Freie Waldorfschulen, and the full-time vocational schools (Vollzeitform) Berufsfachschulen, Berufsoberschulen/Technische Oberschulen, Fachgymnasien and Fachoberschulen. Out of scope, with the national size in pupils / teacher FTE: part-time vocational schools (all Teilzeitform, the school half of the dual apprenticeship: 1 424 601 pupils); Abendgymnasien 7 369 / 713 and Kollegs 8 498 / 904 (second chance for adults); the prevocational years Berufsvorbereitungsjahr 136 542 / 12 211, Berufsgrundbildungsjahr 4 721 / 530 and Berufsaufbauschulen 21 / 1.5; the post-secondary Fachschulen 100 516 / 7 253 and Fachakademien 13 534 / 1 447. The year is 2024/25 for every Land: in 2025/26 Nordrhein-Westfalen has no Abitur class (the Gymnasien's switch from eight to nine years), which would leave one upper year missing; Schleswig-Holstein was not checked beyond its 2024/25 count being in line with the other Laender. capacity = the Land's full-time upper-secondary pupils (enrolled pupils, not places; 1 392 662 in all). pupils_per_teacher level = capacity over the teacher FTE of the same rows; national upper_secondary_pupils_per_teacher 11.71 (118 911 FTE). units = schools, Destatis Statistischer Bericht 21111 and 21121, school year 2024/25, tables 21111-01 and 21121-01 (https://www.destatis.de/DE/Themen/Gesellschaft-Umwelt/Bildung-Forschung-Kultur/Schulen/_inhalt.html): Gymnasien, Schularten mit drei Bildungsgaengen, Freie Waldorfschulen, Berufsfachschulen, Berufsoberschulen, Fachgymnasien, Fachoberschulen; a school counts once for each type offered, and the comprehensive and Waldorf schools without upper years are counted too, so the mean enrolment per school (141) is understated; units are informational. hospital: units = hospitals (Krankenhaeuser) and capacity = set-up beds (aufgestellte Betten) per Land in 2025, Destatis, Statistischer Bericht 'Grunddaten der Krankenhaeuser - Bundeslaender' (file statistischer-bericht-grunddaten-krankenhaeuser-bundeslaender-2120611257005.xlsx, https://www.destatis.de/DE/Themen/Gesellschaft-Umwelt/Gesundheit/Krankenhauser/Publikationen/_publikationen-innen-grunddaten-krankenhaus.html, table 23111-b02, Destatis's own sheet; its csv sheet omits Sachsen-Anhalt and is not used). hospital_beds_per_1000 = the same table's beds per 100 000 inhabitants over 100 (Destatis's population base), its Deutschland row (5.61) for the national value. The catalogue's capacity for a hospital is the mean of the general hospitals (Allgemeine Krankenhaeuser, table 23111-b14: 420 922 beds in 1 452 hospitals = 290). Self-checks: for every in-scope row of Z1.2 and Z3.2 the 16 Laender add up to KMK's Deutschland column, and the Laender's hospitals (1 807) and beds (468 803) add up to Destatis's Deutschland row. The levels weighted by the regions' `share` give each `national` back within 0.3 % (the loader's tolerance is 3 %). Licences: KMK's Dokumentation states no licence, the figures are Destatis statistics processed by the KMK Secretariat and are used here as cited facts (LicenseRef-KMK-Statistics); Destatis's reports carry 'Vervielfaeltigung und Verbreitung, auch auszugsweise, mit Quellenangabe gestattet' (LicenseRef-Destatis-Reproduction). Read 2026-11-17. A level is the region's own value in the figure's unit.
